limits: Limits: one skill (test-audit), 42 lessons, one model, `claude -p` mode, 5 paired repetitions (a sign test cannot reach p < 0.05 with 5 pairs, so the gate is an effect size), a biased gold (3 planned lessons chosen with the scores visible), a judge that is itself a model, and lexical information measures. Static evidence alone never gives more than low confidence.
